about: Follow-up 3 to STORY-009, 2026-09-24. Unlike follow-ups 1 and 2, these changes were made AFTER seeing every pilot case, to close the two misses in pilot/results/followup-2.json (holdout-016, holdout-022). No unseen cases remain, so a pass after these changes shows the fixes work on known cases; it is not an independent test of new wording.

changes.reason: Kubernetes eviction message for memory pressure (holdout-016).

changes.rule: A logfmt level field (level=error / level=fatal / level=warn / level=warning / level=info, case-insensitive) sets the line's level and takes precedence over bare uppercase words.
changes.reason: Go and other logfmt services write lowercase levels (holdout-022). Deliberately narrow: bare lowercase words such as 'error' in a message still do not set a level.
Allow backslash-escaped quotes around the column name, as they appear inside a quoted logfmt value (holdout-022).

recommendation: Before autonomous operation, confirm with cases the developer did not write (real incidents or cases written by someone else).
